reason: In salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:75-84, getClient always POSTs a refresh_token request and skips refreshOAuthTokens. It saves the parsed token at :96-99 but builds the Connection from the old credentialKey.access_token at :105-106. In sync mode, parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:199-200 uses minimumTokenResponseSchema, a plain z.object whose computed keys collapse to "[object Object]", so zod's default stripping drops instance_url and other fields. Because that function throws on failure (:205-206), the !success branch at CalendarService.ts:92-94 can never run.
